claims.text: Flutter renders a frame in phases: build (widgets produce the tree), layout (sizes and positions), then paint.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: resources/architectural-overview (rendering pipeline: build, layout, paint)

claims.text: In layout, constraints go down, sizes go up, and the parent sets the position; a widget chooses its size within its parent's constraints.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: ui/layout/constraints.md ('Constraints go down. Sizes go up. Parent sets position.')

claims.text: Center expands to fill the space it is given (when bounded), passes its child loosened constraints, and positions the child in its middle.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: ui/layout/constraints.md (Center examples); Flutter API: Center/Align

claims.text: ProductListScreen's FutureBuilder returns Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()) while waiting and Center(child: Text(...)) on error; each product is a ListTile with title Text(name) and trailing Text(price).
A ListView gives each child the full cross-axis (width) of the list; ListTile lays out trailing at the end with the width it needs and gives title the remaining width.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API docs / SDK source: ListView (tight cross-axis), ListTile layout

claims.text: Resizing the browser window changes the constraints given to the app, so layout runs again and the spinner stays centred with the same size.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: ui/layout/constraints.md; Flutter web window resize

claims.text: When only a colour changes, sizes stay the same and only painting has to be redone.
Paint needs layout's results and layout needs build's tree, so the phases run in that order.
